question: In which Indian state is Rushikonda Beach, which received the Blue Flag Beach certification in 2023, located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andhra Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rushikonda Beach** is located in the state of **Andhra Pradesh**, India.
 
• It is situated near **Visakhapatnam**, a prominent coastal city in Andhra Pradesh.
 
• **Rushikonda Beach** was awarded the prestigious **Blue Flag Certification** in **2023**, recognizing it as an environmentally sustainable and clean beach. *Hence, the location is correct.*
 
• The **Blue Flag Certification** is an international recognition granted by the **Foundation for Environmental Education (FEE)**, Denmark, to beaches that meet stringent environmental, safety, and cleanliness standards.
 
• Rushikonda Beach is known for its **pristine waters** and is a major tourist destination in Andhra Pradesh. *Hence, the answer is correct.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Blue Flag Certification:**

 
 
• **Blue Flag Certification** is a globally recognized eco-label awarded to beaches, marinas, and sustainable boating tourism operators.
 
• It is administered by the **Foundation for Environmental Education (FEE)**, based in Denmark.
 
• The certification ensures that the beach meets **33 stringent criteria**, which include water quality, environmental management, safety, and services.
 
 
 
• **Rushikonda Beach:**
 
 
• Located in **Visakhapatnam**, Andhra Pradesh, Rushikonda Beach is a popular tourist destination for its scenic beauty and water sports activities.
 
• The beach is managed by the local authorities to maintain its cleanliness and provide visitors with adequate safety measures.
 
• It is known for its **environmentally friendly practices**, which contributed to its **Blue Flag Certification**.
 
 
 
• **Other Blue Flag Beaches in India:**
 
 
• India currently has **12 Blue Flag beaches**, including **Rushikonda Beach**.
 
• Other certified beaches include **Kappad Beach** in Kerala, **Golden Beach** in Odisha, and **Ghoghla Beach** in Diu.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Criteria for Blue Flag Certification:**

 
 
• The beach must meet standards related to **water quality**, **environmental management**, **safety**, and **education**.
 
• It must have **clean sanitation facilities**, lifeguards, and proper signage to educate visitors about eco-friendly practices.
 
 
 
• **Significance for India:**
 
 
• The inclusion of Indian beaches in the **Blue Flag list** highlights the country's commitment to sustainable tourism and environmental conservation.
 
• This certification promotes India as a global tourist destination while ensuring that beaches remain clean and safe for visitors.
